articles.title: Fireblocks launches agentic payment support, joins x402 Foundation
articles.snippet: If even a fraction of the more than 1 billion people who use AI daily delegate authority to AI agents for online spending, stablecoin adoption would grow substantially, a Fireblocks executive said.

articles.title: South Carolina governor signs bill protecting Bitcoin miners, banning CBDC
articles.snippet: Senate Bill 163 bans CBDC payments by state agencies and shields Bitcoin miners from discriminatory zoning and licensing rules.

articles.title: US Senate advances resolution to curb Trump’s Iran war powers
articles.snippet: “Congress has the power to slam the brakes on this unwise conflict,” said bill sponsor and Democratic Senator Tim Kaine.

articles.title: CFTC sues Minnesota, Governor Tim Walz over prediction markets ban
articles.snippet: About 24 hours after Minnesota Governor Tim Walz signed a bill into law passed by the state’s legislature to effectively ban prediction markets in the state, the CFTC pushed back with its own lawsuit.

articles.title: Bernstein: Bitcoin miners becoming critical suppliers in AI infrastructure
articles.snippet: Bernstein says miners control 27 GW of planned power and $90 billion in AI deals, giving them a strategic edge as electricity becomes the main constraint on data center growth.
